ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the queue. When it matches a stored queue, that queue is updated. Otherwise a new queue is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

QueueGroupId.description: Optional queue-group identifier used for catalog organization and reporting. Queue groups do not affect routing.

DefaultPriority.description: Default priority applied to items added to the queue.

RoutingStrategy.description: Strategy used to choose which available agent receives the next queued item.

PreferStickyAgent.description: Whether routing prefers the activity's last assigned user when that agent is eligible and available.

EnableSlaAging.description: Whether a waiting item's effective priority increases the longer it waits beyond the SLA threshold.

SlaThresholdSeconds.description: Service-level threshold, in seconds, after which a waiting item breaches SLA.

ReservationTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a reservation remains valid before it expires and the item is re-queued.

UnansweredOfferAction.description: What happens when an offered reservation expires before the agent accepts it.

BusinessHoursCalendarId.description: Identifier of the business-hours calendar that gates when the queue routes work. When empty, the queue routes around the clock.

AfterHoursAction.description: Action taken for waiting items while the queue's business-hours calendar reports closed.

OverflowQueueId.description: Identifier of the queue that receives overflowed items. When empty, overflow is disabled.

OverflowAfterSeconds.description: Seconds an item may wait before it overflows to the overflow queue. Zero disables wait-time overflow.

items.description: A skill identifier required to handle work from this queue.

RequiredSkills.description: Skills required to be eligible to handle work from this queue.

Enabled.description: Whether the queue is enabled for routing.

InboundChannelEndpointId.description: Identifier of the inbound channel endpoint (dialed number or DID) whose calls are routed to this queue.

FirstResponseTargetSeconds.description: Seconds a messaging contact may wait for a first reply on this queue before the thread is treated as breached. Zero disables the first-response target.

SkillId.description: Identifier of the skill the requirement describes.

MinimumProficiency.description: Proficiency an agent must reach to satisfy the requirement.

Required.description: Whether an agent who does not meet the requirement is excluded. When false, the requirement is a preference that ranks candidates instead of eliminating them.

RelaxAfterSeconds.description: Seconds a contact may wait before the requirement is dropped, or null when it never is.

SkillRequirements.description: What the queue needs from the agent who takes its work: the proficiency of each skill, whether it is required or preferred, and when it relaxes. Skills listed only in 'RequiredSkills' are read as hard requirements at the default proficiency.

QueueId.description: Identifier of the queue a waiting caller moves to.

AfterSeconds.description: Seconds the caller must have waited before this hop applies.

OverflowTargets.description: Ordered overflow chain describing where a waiting caller widens to and after how long. It supersedes the single 'OverflowQueueId' hop.

MaxWaitSeconds.description: Longest time, in seconds, the queue makes anybody wait. Zero means no limit.

MaxWaitAction.description: What happens to a caller who reaches 'MaxWaitSeconds'.

MaxQueueSize.description: How many callers may wait at once. Zero means no limit.

QueueFullAction.description: What happens to a caller who arrives at a full queue.

WelcomeMessage.description: Message played once when the caller enters the queue.

AnnouncementIntervalSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the periodic announcement repeats. Zero means never.

AnnouncePosition.description: Whether the announcement states the caller's position in line.

AnnounceEstimatedWait.description: Whether the announcement states the estimated wait.

HoldMusicMediaId.description: Voice media reference of the hold music.

CallbackDtmfKey.description: Single telephone key that accepts a callback, or null when no callback is offered.

CallbackOfferAfterSeconds.description: Seconds the caller waits before the callback is offered.

MinimumEstimateSeconds.description: Shortest wait, in seconds, the queue quotes.

MaximumEstimateSeconds.description: Longest wait, in seconds, the queue quotes. Past it the announcement says nothing about time.

AverageHandleTimeSeconds.description: Configured average handle time, in seconds, used to estimate the wait.

Treatment.description: What callers hear while they wait: the welcome message, periodic announcements, hold music and the callback offer.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the queue, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Queues.description: The Contact Center queues to create or update.
